### enum `BundleError`

Why a bundle was refused whole. Every variant is a property of the bundle itself — nothing here names a write failure, which stays `std::io::Error` with the caller.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Error, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum BundleError {
    #[error("the bundle carries a file with no path")]
    NoPath,
    #[error("a bundle may not carry {path:?} — that directory is generated here")]
    GeneratedDir {
        path: String,
    },
    #[error("refusing {path:?}: {cause}")]
    Escaped {
        path: String,
        cause: String,
    },
    #[error("{path:?} names the dashboard itself")]
    NamesItself {
        path: String,
    },
    #[error("{path:?} is not valid base64: {cause}")]
    NotBase64 {
        path: String,
        cause: String,
    },
    #[error("the bundle is too large")]
    TooLarge,
    #[error("the bundle carries too many files")]
    TooManyFiles,
}
```

### enum `CollectError`

The failure modes of packing a directory into a bundle.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum CollectError {
    #[error(transparent)]
    Io(std::io::Error),
    #[error( "this dashboard is too large to transfer ({} files, {} bytes so far; the limits are \ {MAX_BUNDLE_FILES} files and {MAX_BUNDLE_BYTES} bytes) — move the bulk of it out of the \ dashboard directory, or copy it across by hand", files, bytes )]
    TooLarge {
        files: usize,
        bytes: u64,
    },
}
```

## `src/hive.rs`

### struct `HiveFile`

The proxy-relevant subset of a dashboard's hive file — enough to tell whether it already declares one origin, and which host it declares. Unknown fields (runners, restart policy) are ignored: this parse decides *whether* to rewrite, never what to keep.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
pub struct HiveFile {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub services: BTreeMap<String, HiveService>,
}
```
